authority: Statistician (ai_quant_lab, branch statistician-foundation) -- design/specification authority only, per Contract Statistician<->Validation Engine SS1.7. This file is consumed by loaders and executing divisions; it is not modified by them. Any change requires a new version and a re-issued hash.
structural_gap_this_file_closes: Statistician's protocols live in ai_quant_lab; the loader and data live in ai_quant_lab-alpha-automation. Executing divisions had no mechanically-readable copy of the governing split rules. This file is that copy, published on branch alpha-automation-v1.

fail_closed_default.rule: Any timeframe, or any regime segment within a timeframe, whose status below is not exactly "VALIDATED" MUST be treated by every loader as FULLY SEALED -- zero bars readable as discovery, zero bars usable for parameterization or testing. A missing, pending, or partially-populated status is never to be treated as "open" or "discovery by default".
fail_closed_default.reason: The documented failure mode is a loader reading an un-partitioned timeframe as entirely discovery and silently burning the sealed half. Fail-closed makes that failure mode structurally impossible: an unfinished config blocks access instead of granting it.

same_window_resampled_predicate.description: A test on timeframe B is NOT an independent confirmation of a hypothesis whose parameters were fixed using timeframe A data if the two calendar windows overlap, regardless of which resolution is finer, and regardless of which half of any timeframe's own discovery/sealed split the overlapping portion falls into.

inputs.parameterization_window: {start_epoch, end_epoch} -- the calendar range of data (at any timeframe) that informed the hypothesis's frozen parameters
inputs.test_window: {start_epoch, end_epoch, timeframe} -- the calendar range and resolution of the data proposed as a confirmation test

same_window_resampled_predicate.formula: overlap_seconds = max(0, min(parameterization_window.end_epoch, test_window.end_epoch) - max(parameterization_window.start_epoch, test_window.start_epoch))
same_window_resampled_predicate.action_if_true: Label the result SAME-WINDOW-RESAMPLED. Never report it as an independent, out-of-sample, or cross-resolution confirmation. This holds even if test_window falls entirely inside the sealed half of its own timeframe's split -- overlap with another timeframe's parameterization window is evaluated independently of that timeframe's own internal split.
same_window_resampled_predicate.action_if_false: Eligible to be reported as an independent confirmation, subject to every other applicable rule (borrowed-parameter provenance, family-wise correction, etc.).

margin_factor.note: The single safety-margin factor used consistently across every embargo derivation below (960->1000 M15 bars; 2880->3000 M5 bars; 240->250 H1 bars). Applied, not re-chosen, at each resolution.

M15.split_method_justification: This is the CURRENT, already-loadable, already-in-production M15 dataset (already whitelisted in the loader alongside H1/H4/D1) -- distinct from the extended 2011-2026 'M15 v2' dataset referenced separately in Research Lab's FOUR_REGIME_RUN_STATUS_v1.0.md, which is NOT yet connected (P1 unmet there) and is OUT OF SCOPE for this manifest. Re-deriving a fresh regime-segment-stratified split for this already-live dataset now would retroactively unsettle a large body of already-closed, CEO-ratified determinations (DC-0003, DC-0004, S18 certification, scoped-FDR) that were built on its existing single cutoff. The existing cutoff is therefore preserved as-is, not recomputed.
M15.cutoff_provenance: Pre-existing sealed_registry boundary (VE), predates this manifest and the stratified-split rule; preserved unchanged.
M15.embargo_note_governance: This 1000-bar embargo band was NOT applied when the original cutoff was set and used for already-closed work (DC-0003, DC-0004, S18, scoped-FDR). It is added here going forward, which only tightens protection (shrinks usable discovery/sealed edges, never expands them) -- a safe direction. Flagged, not auto-resolved: whether any already-closed determination used discovery-side data inside what is now the embargo band is a governance question for CEO, not something this manifest adjudicates.

dataset.date_precision_note: Start/end given at date resolution by Data Acquisition's report; exact first/last-bar HH:MM:SS to be confirmed by Data Acquisition and substituted here without changing this file's version (a value correction, not a rule change).

M5.split_method_justification: Same principle as M15-extended's original design: mechanical, disclosed regime map, split within each contiguous segment (not one global cutoff), 50/50 default with a documented 60/40 exception only for a segment too short for 50% discovery to be useful, decided before results.
M5.embargo_derivation: TRACK_HORIZON=960 M15 bars = 864000s = 10 days. M15/M5 bar-second ratio = 900/300 = 3. Raw M5-equivalent = 960*3 = 2880 bars. Margin factor 25/24 applied: 2880*25/24 = 3000.
M5.loader_contract: Per fail_closed_default above: while status != VALIDATED, 100% of M5 bars are SEALED. No discovery access permitted. Data Acquisition may whitelist M5 in the loader code now; the data itself stays inert until a mechanical regime map is delivered and this entry is updated to status VALIDATED with populated regime_segments/discovery_range/embargo_range/sealed_range, in a new manifest version with a new hash.

dataset.date_precision_note: Same date-resolution caveat as M5 above.

H1.split_method_justification: Same principle, applied to H1's own window. 2006-03-20 to (at least) 2011-07-25 has never been observed in this lab at any resolution, including the withdrawn M15-extended attempt -- the single most irreplaceable segment in the lab's history. No different split ratio is derived for it without a clean justification; heightened governance vigilance against discretionary access is recorded instead, see STATISTICIAN_H1_PREREGISTRATION_PROTOCOL_v1.0.md SS1.
H1.embargo_derivation: TRACK_HORIZON=960 M15 bars = 864000s = 10 days. M15/H1 bar-second ratio = 3600/900 = 4. Raw H1-equivalent = 960/4 = 240 bars. Margin factor 25/24 applied: 240*25/24 = 250.
H1.loader_contract: Per fail_closed_default above: while status != VALIDATED, 100% of H1 bars are SEALED. No discovery access permitted, including the never-seen 2006-2011 segment -- its irreplaceability is a reason for MORE caution before opening it, not less.

out_of_scope_note: An extended 'M15 v2' dataset (2011-2026) is referenced in ai_quant_lab/docs/FOUR_REGIME_RUN_STATUS_v1.0.md as a precondition for a separate four-regime measurement run. That dataset is NOT connected (Research Lab's own P1 status: unmet) and is NOT the 'M15' entry above. Do not conflate the two -- when M15 v2 is actually connected and verified, it requires its own timeframe entry in a future manifest version, not a silent merge into the current M15 entry.
